```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(knitr)
library(patchwork)

nola_data <- readRDS("nola_data.rds")
```

## Executive Summary & Category Selection

To investigate where to find the best specialty treats in New Orleans, this project examines three closely related restaurant categories:

*Bakeries:* Specializing in pastries, breads, and baked goods.

*Desserts:* Offering plated desserts, cakes, and specialty sweets.

*Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt:* Quick-serve frozen treats.

Zipcodes to compare:

*70116 (French Quarter / Faubourg Marigny)*

*70115 (Uptown / Magazine Street Corridor)*

*70130 (Lower Garden District / Warehouse District / CBD)*

*70119 (Mid-City / Fairgrounds)*

*70118 (Uptown / Carrollton / University Area)*

Currently, clear macro-level trends between high-volume tourist hubs (70116) and high-rated residential neighborhood markets (70115) are in the lead for best dessert spots in New Orleans.

## Category Counts and Co-Occurrence Evidence

```{r}
#| label: category-analysis

restaurant_categories <- nola_data |>
  filter(!is.na(categories)) |>
  separate_rows(categories, sep = ",") |>
  mutate(category = str_to_lower(str_trim(categories))) |>
  filter(category != "")

target_cats <- c("bakery", "desserts", "ice cream & frozen yogurt")

co_occurrence <- restaurant_categories |>
  filter(category %in% target_cats) |>
  inner_join(
    restaurant_categories |> filter(category %in% target_cats),
    by = "business_id",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  filter(category.x < category.y) |>
  count(category.x, category.y, name = "Co_Occurrence_Count", sort = TRUE)

kable(co_occurrence, caption = "Pairwise Co-Occurrence Counts Among Selected Dessert Categories")
```

Inclusion rule, at least one inclusion rule ($C_{\text{bakery}} \cup C_{\text{desserts}} \cup C_{\text{ice cream}}$) to capture the full market of sweet treat establishments without artificially restricting multi-category artisan shops.

```{r}
#| label: inclusion-rule

selected_business_ids <- restaurant_categories |>
  filter(category %in% target_cats) |>
  distinct(business_id)

selected_businesses <- nola_data |>
  inner_join(selected_business_ids, by = "business_id")
```

## Volume and Metric Summaries

```{r}
#| label: join-reviews

reviews_raw <- readRDS("nola_Reviews.rds")

category_reviews <- reviews_raw |>
  rename_with(str_to_lower) |> 
  semi_join(selected_businesses, by = "business_id") |>
  mutate(
    review_date = ymd(date),
    review_year = year(review_date)
  )

all_reviewer_summary <- category_reviews |>
  group_by(business_id) |>
  summarise(
    number_of_reviews_all_reviewers = n(),
    average_stars_all_reviewers = mean(stars, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_stars_all_reviewers = median(stars, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(head(all_reviewer_summary, 5), caption = "Sample Review Summaries by Business")
```

## Spacial Joins & Mismatch

```{r}
#| label: spatial-join-setup

louisiana_places <- tigris::places(
  state = "LA",
  cb = TRUE,
  year = 2024,
  class = "sf"
) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  mutate(place_name = NAME)

restaurant_points <- selected_businesses |>
  filter(!is.na(longitude), !is.na(latitude)) |>
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  )

restaurants_with_place <- restaurant_points |>
  st_join(
    louisiana_places |> select(GEOID, place_name),
    join = st_within,
    left = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: mismatch-check

mismatch_summary <- restaurants_with_place |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  count(city, place_name, sort = TRUE)

kable(head(mismatch_summary, 10), caption = "Comparison of Yelp City Labels vs. Official Census Place Names")
```

## Geography

```{r}
#| label: geo-summary-initial

global_avg_stars <- mean(selected_businesses$stars, na.rm = TRUE)

geo_summary <- selected_businesses |>
  filter(!is.na(postal_code) & postal_code != "") |>
  group_by(postal_code) |>
  summarize(
    Restaurant_Count = n(),
    Avg_Stars = round(mean(stars, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Total_Reviews = sum(review_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Reviews = round(mean(review_count, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Adjusted_Score = round(
      (sum(review_count * stars) + 50 * global_avg_stars) / (sum(review_count) + 50), 2
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(Restaurant_Count > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(Restaurant_Count))

kable(geo_summary, caption = "Geographic Performance Summary Across Postal Codes")

cat("Total distinct postal codes represented:", nrow(geo_summary), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: map-visualization
#| fig.width: 8
#| fig.height: 6

new_orleans_boundary <- louisiana_places |>
  filter(place_name == "New Orleans")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = new_orleans_boundary, fill = "grey95", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_sf(
    data = restaurant_points,
    aes(color = stars),
    alpha = 0.85,
    size = 2.2
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C", limits = c(1, 5)) +
  labs(
    title = "Late-Night Sweets & Treats in New Orleans",
    subtitle = "Spatial distribution and star ratings across postal zones",
    color = "Business\nStars",
    caption = "Source: Yelp Open Dataset & US Census TIGER/Line"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: load-geographic-boundaries

zcta_boundaries <- zctas(
  year = 2020,
  cb = TRUE,
  progress_bar = FALSE
) |>
  filter(str_starts(ZCTA5CE20, "70|71")) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  select(area_id = ZCTA5CE20, area_name = ZCTA5CE20)

tract_boundaries <- tracts(
  state = "LA",
  county = "071",
  year = 2022,
  cb = TRUE,
  progress_bar = FALSE
) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  select(area_id = GEOID, area_name = NAMELSAD)
```

```{r}
#| label: execute-spatial-comparison

analyze_geo_system <- function(points_sf, boundaries_sf, system_label) {
  joined <- points_sf |>
    st_join(boundaries_sf, join = st_within, left = TRUE) |>
    st_drop_geometry()
  
  unmatched_count <- sum(is.na(joined$area_id))
  matched_count <- sum(!is.na(joined$area_id))
  
  area_counts <- joined |>
    filter(!is.na(area_id)) |>
    count(area_id, name = "n_restaurants")
  
  tibble(
    `Geographic system` = system_label,
    `Number of areas` = n_distinct(boundaries_sf$area_id),
    `Restaurants assigned` = matched_count,
    `Unmatched restaurants` = unmatched_count,
    `Smallest area count` = if (nrow(area_counts) > 0) min(area_counts$n_restaurants) else 0,
    `Largest area count` = if (nrow(area_counts) > 0) max(area_counts$n_restaurants) else 0
  )
}

zcta_metrics <- analyze_geo_system(restaurant_points, zcta_boundaries, "ZIP/ZCTA")
tract_metrics <- analyze_geo_system(restaurant_points, tract_boundaries, "Census Tract")

geo_system_comparison <- bind_rows(zcta_metrics, tract_metrics)

kable(
  geo_system_comparison,
  caption = "Comparison of Candidate Geographic Boundary Systems in New Orleans"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-geo-comparison-map
#| fig.width: 10
#| fig.height: 5
#| fig.cap: "Spatial Comparison of Sweet Treat Establishments: ZCTA vs. Census Tract Boundaries"

zcta_joined <- restaurant_points |>
  st_join(zcta_boundaries, join = st_within, left = TRUE)

tract_joined <- restaurant_points |>
  st_join(tract_boundaries, join = st_within, left = TRUE)

p1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = zcta_boundaries, fill = "grey95", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = zcta_joined, aes(color = stars), alpha = 0.8, size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C", limits = c(1, 5)) +
  labs(title = "ZIP / ZCTA Boundaries", color = "Stars") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))

p2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = tract_boundaries, fill = "grey95", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = tract_joined, aes(color = stars), alpha = 0.8, size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C", limits = c(1, 5)) +
  labs(title = "Census Tract Boundaries", color = "Stars") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))

p1 + p2 + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```



```{r}
#| label: geo-summary-table-and-chart
#| fig.cap: "Restaurant Count and Performance by Postal Zone"

global_avg_stars <- mean(selected_businesses$stars, na.rm = TRUE)

geo_summary <- selected_businesses |>
  filter(!is.na(postal_code) & postal_code != "") |>
  group_by(postal_code) |>
  summarize(
    Restaurant_Count = n(),
    Avg_Stars = round(mean(stars, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Total_Reviews = sum(review_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    Adjusted_Score = round(
      (sum(review_count * stars) + 50 * global_avg_stars) / (sum(review_count) + 50), 2
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(Restaurant_Count > 1) |>
  arrange(desc(Restaurant_Count))

kable(geo_summary, caption = "Performance Summary Across Postal Codes")

geo_summary |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  mutate(postal_code = fct_reorder(postal_code, Restaurant_Count)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Restaurant_Count, y = postal_code, fill = Adjusted_Score)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", name = "Bayesian\nScore") +
  labs(
    title = "Top Postal Codes by Sweet Treat Density",
    subtitle = "Colored by Bayesian adjusted rating score",
    x = "Number of Restaurants",
    y = "Postal Code (ZCTA)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
